title: Roblox Gravity Coil
blurb: Springy, cartoonish, and the closest Roblox ever came to unplugging physics. The Gravity Coil let a whole generation float across obbies, and its boing is one of the platform's oldest surviving sounds. Anybody who spent 2012 in a free-model game hunting for a coil somebody had left lying around will feel it immediately. Short and very satisfying. It works as a jump cue in edits, or as a punchline for anyone who trips over nothing at all.
origin: The Gravity Coil gear sound from Roblox.
